citazioni: On compression of BaP-I (P21/c) to 4.8 GPa in an He pressure medium, we observed a phase transition to a previously unknown monoclinic polymorph BaP-II (P21/c).
SC-XRD studies at room temperature were conducted in DAC No. 1 and DAC No. 2
in the BaP-I to BaP-II transformation, the applied stress leads to an abrupt change in the intermolecular angle from 73.5° at 2.2 GPa in BaP-I to 53.5° at 4.8 GPa in BaP-II
eventi.note: La transizione sta fra 2,2 GPa (ultimo punto di BaP-I) e 4,8 GPa (BaP-II risolta). SCSC: la struttura di BaP-II e' risolta in situ sullo stesso cristallo singolo, anche se l'articolo non usa la parola.

citazioni: The next phase transition occurred at 7.1 GPa to BaP-III with a triclinic structure (P1), which was preserved up to about 28 GPa.
Further compression of BaP-II to 7.1 GPa results in a decrease of symmetry to P1, indicating the transformation to BaP-III.
The second previously unknown polymorph, BaP-III, was detected at 7.1 GPa and preserved under an He pressure medium up to 27.9 GPa.
